The '''Giju Run''' or the '''Giju Passage''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] located along the border of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. The Giju Run ran past [[Giju/Legends|Giju]], the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] homeworld, which was located on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], into the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], reaching its terminus at [[Tallaan]], where it intersected with the [[Shapani Bypass/Legends|Shapani Bypass]] and the [[Procopian Shipping Lane]].
